category: Application Library examples: Ray Optics Module (2/2)
description: Ready-made, documented example simulations installed with the Ray Optics Module. Each lists its physics interfaces, couplings and study steps; solve one with comsol_run_example or adapt its Java build script.

tools.name: Vdara® Caustic Surface [Ray Optics Module example]
tools.description: Application Library example of the Ray Optics Module (Solar Radiation): Vdara® Caustic Surface. Physics interfaces: Geometrical Optics (gop). Study steps: Ray Tracing. A ready model to start from for a similar simulation.
tools.usage: MCP: comsol_run_example("Ray_Optics_Module/Solar_Radiation/vdara_caustic_surface") to solve it, comsol_example_info("vdara_caustic_surface", include_java=true) for its build script. COMSOL: File > Application Libraries > Ray Optics Module > Solar Radiation > vdara caustic surface

parameters.name: gop
parameters.description: physics interface Geometrical Optics (API type GeometricalOptics)

tools.notes: Library path Ray_Optics_Module/Solar_Radiation/vdara_caustic_surface; model file 0.6 MB. Documented Java build script available (rebuild with comsol_run_example method='java'). Requires the module licence to open and solve.
